newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez property problems may show up in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Suez property problems may show up in 1997.

text.p: Cie de Suez's property exposure may weigh on the 1997 results of the proposed new Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux entity, Suez Chairman Gerard Mestrallet told an analysts' meeting on Monday.

"We wouldn't rule out the possibility that Suez's property assets could still weigh slightly on 1997," Mestrallet said. He added that, with a property risk of 4.8 billion francs, a price fall of 10 percent would cost the group 480 million francs.
He said the profit goal of 3.5 billion francs set by Suez Lyonnaise assumes a further deterioration in property prices but did not elaborate.
Suez reduced its property loan portfolio last year to nine billion francs, and its merger partner Lyonnaise cut its property assets to 1.5 billion francs.
